firms.name: K1 Investment Management
firms.facts: K1 describes a small-cap AI-enabled enterprise-technology strategy and a single-office operating model. Its historical Certify/Chrome River transaction gave K1 majority ownership while founders and other holders retained a minority.
firms.fit: Hypothesis: legal/document workflow, systems of record and software operating support could help Circularo scale internationally.
firms.secondary: Historical majority transaction with founder rollover; founder cash proceeds and current Circularo secondary terms unknown.
firms.ticket: Current applicable cheque range not established.
firms.gate: Qualify company scale, primary/secondary allocation and portfolio overlap before sharing detailed product plans.
firms.hook: your experience backing enterprise software founders

firms.name: Arrowroot Capital
firms.facts: Arrowroot publishes minority and majority equity/debt investments, with initial checks of USD 10m–100m+. Its company LinkedIn description explicitly includes primary and secondary transactions.
firms.fit: Hypothesis: flexible software growth investment and hands-on sales/operating support could combine founder liquidity with expansion.
firms.secondary: Explicit primary/secondary scope in first-party LinkedIn description; founder-specific allocation requires confirmation.
firms.ticket: Published USD 10m–100m+ initial checks; USD 4m is below its published range, but the batch has no upper cap.
firms.gate: Confirm the relevant equity vehicle and economic fit; a debt-only solution does not satisfy founder-share purchase needs.
firms.hook: Arrowroot's flexible approach to software growth and secondary transactions

firms.name: Marlin Equity Partners
firms.facts: Marlin specialises in software/technology and mid/lower-mid-market situations. Its completed 2019 Skuid transaction combined majority recapitalisation and growth investment.
firms.fit: Hypothesis: workflow expertise, operating resources and strategic acquisitions could support Circularo's international growth.
firms.secondary: Completed majority recapitalisation precedent, with shareholder-liquidity language; cash paid specifically to founders not established.
firms.ticket: Current applicable equity-ticket floor not established.
firms.gate: Ask about a standalone investment versus a portfolio-company acquisition, management rollover and product/portfolio boundaries.
firms.hook: Marlin's software investment and recapitalisation experience

firms.name: March Capital
firms.facts: March's venture-growth remit includes enterprise applications and cloud/data infrastructure. Jed leads cybersecurity investing; Jamie is co-founder/managing partner and founder of The Montgomery Summit.
firms.fit: Hypothesis: cybersecurity and enterprise networks could be useful for Circularo's digital-trust direction and US introductions.
firms.secondary: Mandatory founder secondary not established in checked sources.
firms.ticket: Current applicable cheque range not established; round totals and fund size are not cheque evidence.
firms.gate: Qualify stage and willingness to include founder liquidity early. Treat AI-agent execution as future direction rather than a delivered Circularo capability.
firms.hook: your enterprise and cybersecurity investment focus

firms.name: Greycroft
firms.facts: Greycroft lists Dylan as a Los Angeles Partner focused on software/internet, with investments including Rocket.Chat and Together AI.
firms.fit: Hypothesis: enterprise software and AI ecosystem access could provide investment qualification and strategic introductions.
firms.secondary: Founder-secondary appetite unknown; user-supplied batch 03 tip remains preliminary.
firms.gate: Ask whether a suitable growth or other vehicle can meet the founder-secondary requirement; do not recast the opportunity as a primary-only VC round.
firms.hook: your work with Rocket.Chat and Together AI

firms.name: Composition Capital
firms.type: Technology growth capital and private equity
firms.area: Los Angeles; precise meeting area to confirm
firms.facts: Composition explicitly lists primary/secondary, minority/majority investments, workflow automation, and a company profile of USD 8m+ ARR. Nishita and Leon are current co-founders/managing partners, previously at Kayne.
firms.fit: Hypothesis: workflow focus and flexible structure are relevant, subject to the revenue gate.
firms.secondary: Explicit primary and secondary transaction scope; Circularo founder proceeds unconfirmed.
firms.ticket: Current cheque range not published in checked source. USD 8m+ is an ARR criterion, not a cheque.
firms.gate: Material scale hurdle: Circularo's internal draft reports approximately USD 3m recurring-revenue scale, with no approved current ARR evidence. Do not claim it meets USD 8m+ ARR; qualify an exception/add-on route before a meeting pitch.
firms.hook: Composition's workflow focus and flexibility on primary and secondary investment

firms.name: Diversis Capital
firms.facts: Diversis publishes USD 50m–300m+ equity checks, required operational control, recurring-revenue software focus and a presence requirement in North America, Western Europe or Australasia. Its portfolio describes Adlib's document/content automation; Joseph sits on Adlib's board.
firms.fit: Hypothesis: a strategic add-on or larger control transaction could align document/workflow capabilities with international expansion.
firms.secondary: Buyout/owner-partnership scope; exact founder liquidity, rollover and sale terms unknown.
firms.ticket: Published USD 50m–300m+ equity checks for its stated strategy. No lower add-on cheque evidenced.
firms.gate: Control is now acceptable under this batch, but minimum cheque, eligible operating presence and Adlib overlap remain gates. Ask about add-on suitability without assuming an exception.
firms.hook: Diversis's document software and operational growth experience

firms.name: Clearlake Capital Group
firms.type: Private equity and other investment strategies
firms.facts: Clearlake has a software acquisition history. A June 2026 Quest/Anetac announcement identifies Paul as Partner and Managing Director and addresses human, non-human and agentic identity security.
firms.fit: Hypothesis: an operating sponsor in identity/cybersecurity could value Circularo's trusted-transaction direction and GCC opportunity.
firms.secondary: Acquisition activity supports a potential sale route; no applicable founder-secondary policy or Circularo terms established.
firms.ticket: No current applicable cheque floor established; do not infer one from AUM or large acquisition values.
firms.gate: Prioritise a portfolio sponsor/add-on conversation over assuming a small standalone investment. Establish portfolio overlap, founder proceeds and which vehicle invests.
firms.hook: Quest's recent work in identity security for the agentic AI era

firms.name: Upfront Ventures
firms.area: Los Angeles metro; meeting area to confirm
firms.facts: Upfront's company profile includes early-stage and growth investment and enterprise/AI/cybersecurity themes. Kobie's authenticated profile identifies him as a Los Angeles General Partner.
firms.fit: Hypothesis: enterprise/AI discussions and LA investor introductions could be valuable, even if a direct secondary deal is unavailable.
firms.ticket: Current applicable cheque range not established.
firms.gate: Confirm a suitable investment stage/vehicle and mandatory secondary before treating this as a transaction lead.
firms.hook: your writing on knowledge systems and the AI infrastructure layer

firms.name: Bonfire Ventures
firms.facts: Bonfire publishes initial USD 2m–6m seed checks, AI-native B2B focus and US-entity eligibility. Mark is a co-founder; Jennifer is a Los Angeles Principal focused on operational software/vertical AI.
firms.fit: Hypothesis: B2B software go-to-market feedback and introductions could be useful for US expansion.
firms.secondary: Founder secondary not established; seed-round focus is a material mismatch for a founder-liquidity transaction.
firms.ticket: Published USD 2m–6m initial checks; only the upper part overlaps the batch floor.
firms.gate: Use primarily for introductions and market feedback unless it explicitly accepts the secondary structure and company maturity. Circularo's eligible US entity is unverified.
firms.hook: your B2B software and vertical AI investment experience
